expected.title: Arithmetic genus of compactified generic isoresidual curves with two zeros and only simple poles on the Riemann sphere
expected.author: Dawei Chen; Quentin Gendron; Miguel Prado; Guillaume Tahar
expected.difficulty_reason: Adjunction and the published canonical-divisor formulas do not identify this generic residual fiber with the required complete intersection or eliminate its extraneous boundary components. The authors supply the full new arbitrary-linear-residue closure and level-by-level smoothing argument, then use the simple-pole boundary restriction to justify that identification. Their authored horizontal and vertical stratum enumeration and tautological recurrence evaluate the surviving intersections, giving the arithmetic-genus formula rather than leaving a new degeneration calculation to a reference.
